46ecc04c12736e0c87e72bc94ad4bcefb775313d.summary: A CISA advisory on advanced persistent threat (APT) actors exploiting trust relationships in IT service provider networks, such as managed service providers (MSPs) and cloud service providers (CSPs). Since at least May 2016, APT actors have used tactics for cyber espionage and intellectual property theft against MSPs, targeting critical infrastructure sectors including IT, Energy, Healthcare and Public Health, Communications and Critical Manufacturing.
